description: Begin a new night shift at the Dead Letter Office (abandoning any shift in progress). By default you get the week's shared bag of mail; solo=true gives a bag of your own. Returns the opening scene.

clerk_key.description: Optional. A clerk key from an earlier conversation, to continue that shift. Leave out to use this conversation's.

seed.description: Optional seed for a reproducible bag.

solo.description: A private bag instead of the week's shared one.

name: poste_new
title: Begin a shift
